correctness.rationale: For each simplex dimension and fixed degree, conditional polynomial expectation reduces the vertex evaluation reproducer to the invertible beta moment matrix. Its signed L1 norm gives exact vertex supremum norm and negativity. The L2 diagonal follows a telescoping Jacobi identity. Scaling beta to exponential gives convergent Hankel moment systems; Laguerre orthogonality fixes all coefficients and bounded moments yield uniform integrability. For m=2, exact rational moment calculations, roots and beta antiderivative yield the closed formula. The standalone script passed exact-moment and numeric checks, but the infinite claim rests on proof, not experimentation.

value.rationale: The sharp pointwise stability of local high-dimensional simplex polynomial least-squares fitting is a natural numerical-approximation benchmark. It quantifies degree-dependent negativity and endpoint amplification with d^m scaling; m=2 gives a closed finite-d formula and a nontrivial 0.3100125... asymptotic coefficient, distinct from degree-one linear growth. Exact local norms matter without establishing the global projector norm.
